idea: A stealth bomber: a dark machine nothing sees coming, its form drawn only by the light.
world: A strategic bomber that lives in a climate-controlled hangar and flies at night. Its skin swallows radar; its leading edges carry their own treatment; its seams are taped over by a ground crew working by hand.

signature.says: The car's own leading edges, taped. Wherever the car meets the air first (its nose, the crease ahead of the cockpit, the swept edge of its skirts, the lips of its intakes) a band of tape grey runs along the car's own line, as a bomber's leading edges carry their own treatment, and ends where that line ends.

dna.says: Every line is one of the car's own: its creases, panel lines, rounded edges and where the body ends; nothing is drawn across them. A band runs along a line at an even width, 1.2, 4 or 12 cm, and stops square where the line stops. A panel changes grey or sheen whole, edge to edge. The only teeth are fine ones, 1 cm, where a tape meets an opening.

colours.name: Tape grey
colours.job: the leading edges' tape, and a few of the car's own panels, a step lighter

colours.name: Low-vis grey
colours.job: the few small marks, a step darker

colours.name: Canopy gold
colours.job: the accent: the glass's coating, nowhere else

meet: Greys a step apart, never a contrast, meeting only on the car's own lines. Black only inside an opening, gold only in the canopy.

surfaces.job: the skin: radar-absorbing, it swallows the light
the tape: a sheen a step apart, so the seams show only in the light
the gear: the only bare metal, dark

ageing: Kept clean in its hangar, but patched: fresh tape a shade off the old, a panel recoated in a slightly different grey, a soot-dark fan on the tiles behind the heat. No dirt, no chips, no rust.

large.what: the car's own panels in two greys and two sheens: a quiet patchwork that the light reveals

medium.what: tape bands along the leading edges and round the intakes' lips, following the car's lines

small.what: fine teeth where a tape meets an opening; a few low-vis marks a step darker; the canopy's gold

fullness: Sparse and quiet: big uninterrupted dark panels. The detail is in the car's own edges, not in objects laid on it.
never: A line the car doesn't have
An angle or a shape laid on from outside the car's form
Anything bright or shiny, except the canopy's gold
